recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Do not restore a core extension definition; any future wording or conformance change for these gateway extensions should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack after work-group review.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO request to add a core extension for identifying the gateway/mobile application involved in personal health device/generated data when Observation.device identifies the measuring device, with a note that Provenance/AuditEvent can represent the same information.
initial_application: Core commit 3e18984e30ed835567e78db17f64f14710e46e74, titled GF#13968 GF#13868 GF#13144, added a gateway-device row to source/observation/observation-extensions-spreadsheet.xml for Observation with value Reference(Device), cardinality 0..1, and the Provenance/AuditEvent note. A generated core StructureDefinition for observation-gatewayDevice later existed under source/observation/.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from R5 source, including observation-gatewayDevice. Current core has active Observation and Device resources, but Device.gateway is commented out/removed and source/fhir.ini tracks it as a removed/mapped element. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains observation-gatewayDevice for older versions and the later device-gateway replacement for Device and Observation, based on published FHIR-47326/FHIR-47606 decisions.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change is appropriate because the editable extension artifacts live in HL7/fhir-extensions, where the historical Observation gateway extension and its R6 replacement are already represented.
